title: Sequences
$comment: Sequence scenarios, one task each; each is drawn as a sequence diagram whose files are named from the scenario's name.

name.description: The scenario's identity, which also names its sequence diagram's files. Must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ — a rule of this layer alone, deliberately not the AUTOSAR `Identifier` rule.

task.description: The name of the declared task this scenario walks; exactly one per scenario, and every step must be mapped to it.

title.description: The scenario's human-readable title, shown after its name in the heading of its sequence diagram (`sd {name} — {title}`). When empty, the heading is the name alone.

steps.description: The steps of the scenario, in order. Must not be empty and must be an ordered subsequence of the referenced task's runnables.

sequence_step.description: One step of a sequence scenario: the runnable it shows, its component named by exactly one of `swc` and `instance`, with an optional note. The `(swc, instance, runnable)` triple, the absent selector as `null`, is the step's identity; the step must be mapped to the scenario's task, and a step written the same way appears at most once per scenario.

swc.description: The name of the declared software component the step runs in; exactly one of `swc` and `instance` is set. Part of the step's composite identity, and so immutable.

instance.description: The occurrence of a component below the root composition the step runs in, as a `/`-joined path of composition member names from the root composition down — a member of the root is its member name alone, a nested one `outer/inner` — never starting with the root composition's own name; exactly one of `swc` and `instance` is set. Part of the step's composite identity, and so immutable.

runnable.description: The name of a runnable of that component, which must be mapped to the scenario's task. Part of the composite identity, and so immutable.

note.description: Free text shown beside the step on its sequence diagram; when non-empty the step's activation is labelled `{runnable} — {note}`.
